schemaNotice: 專案材質能力契約，並非 B4A 原生 schema；僅由可信靜態來源匯入。雜湊確認來源一致性，不代表畫質或光學認證。
name: MaterialLibrary
registration: Explicit local imports, immutable material IDs and trusted B4A command registry. Input files cannot supply shader code, executable modules or arbitrary material URLs.

inputs.materialId: One of 32 registered presets: 4 legacy and 28 additional procedural presets.
inputs.transform: Existing material command accepts entity ID and materialId only; application validates target kind, material and scene before replacing the model.
inputs.customMaps: Existing strict lumiere-materials image pack parser: embedded PNG/JPEG/WebP and allowed color/normal/roughness/metalness channels. Presets retain physical parameters by stable ID.
inputs.generation: Default 256 pixel square maps; explicit power-of-two size 32–512; fixed local generator and no external images.

outputs: Immutable JSON-serializable preset descriptions with category, source generator and PBR parameters
Standard or physical Three.js material referencing viewport-owned shared maps
Deterministic seamless color, OpenGL normal and roughness pixel maps for patterned presets
B4A categorized/searchable material selection in designer and tour
Agent discovery through existing materials/capabilities commands and existing material write command
Building JSON materialId persistence and complete-project custom-map persistence

authority.read: Trusted preset definitions and explicitly selected local custom image files.
authority.write: Validated in-memory materialId changes, normal scene undo/redo and explicit user downloads. No source-file or draft overwrite without the existing save action.
authority.collision: Material appearance does not change collision, walk support, door state or trace attachments.
authority.network: No cloud services, external image fetching or arbitrary URL resolution.

physicalRendering.optics: Glass and optical plastic use MeshPhysicalMaterial transmission with opacity 1, IOR and thickness. Frosted/translucent presets add roughness or attenuation; this is real-time approximation, not measured optical simulation.
physicalRendering.metalFabric: Metalness/roughness and optional anisotropy for metals; sheen and procedural weave maps for fabric.
physicalRendering.legacy: Original four IDs and original color/roughness/pattern behavior retained, including custom normal-map scale 1.
physicalRendering.environment: Existing RoomEnvironment reflection resource is generated once and reused for optical/metallic presets; rendering integration owns lifecycle.

limits.customMapBudget: Existing image/material/project-bundle byte and image-size validation applies.

targetRules: Shared material-application.js rules refuse unsupported new-preset targets, floor-only misuse and imported GLB replacement. Slab openings have no material-bearing surface and reject new presets; their UI field is disabled. Designer/tour retain existing locked evidence, relationship and group constraints.
limitations: Not a per-face UV editor, camera-projected source-image layer or four-corner photo mapping tool.
Native door/window panes retain their existing glass style; independently modeled glass panels can use the new presets.
Specialized vehicles, roads, school assets, pipes and some scene props retain multi-part/system colors. Imported GLB keeps embedded materials and UVs.
Transparent material does not imply a passable object. Runtime transmission and environment effects are approximate.
materials-library.json is a descriptive catalog, not an importable lumiere-materials image pack.
errors: Unknown IDs, invalid targets, oversized maps or invalid image packs reject without committing a scene/history change. Partial texture allocations are disposed on generation failure.
lifecycle: Procedural maps are shared per viewport; material instances do not dispose map ownership. Viewport reload/destroy and existing disposeMaterialTextures release color and associated PBR maps; environment targets are reused and disposed by the viewport.
verificationScope: Tests cover deterministic pixels and seamless boundaries, immutable presets, legacy/custom-map compatibility, physical material parameters, resource disposal, target refusal, JSON persistence, UI filtering and agent discovery. Browser appearance and hardware performance are separate checks.
rollback: Export scenes before removing presets. Revert material selectors/factory integration and replace added IDs explicitly; unsupported IDs are rejected rather than silently remapped.
